Hiring Now: Sr. Data Analyst 🚨
📍 Location: NYC, NY – Onsite
💼 Job Type: Contract
🎥 Interview Mode: Video + Face-to-Face
 Visa: USC, GC, GC EAD & H4 EAD Only

🔹 Key Responsibilities:
Perform EV Data Analysis and analyze complex datasets.
Design and maintain program data for business and analytical needs.
Conduct statistical analysis to identify trends and patterns for diagnostic and predictive analytics.
Identify and resolve coding errors and other data-related issues.
Mine data from primary and secondary sources.
Clean, reorganize, and transform data into formats suitable for human and machine analysis.
Support business data analysis and reporting requirements.
🔹 Must-Have Technical Skills:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
Strong Business Data Analysis experience.
Ability to interpret, modify, and write scripts and SQL queries.
Experience with one or more of the following:
Apps / .NET Development
Azure Cloud
Azure Data Engineering
Azure Databricks
Azure Data Factory
Azure Logic Apps
Power BI
Power BI Report Server
Python

Master’s Degree preferred.
📩 Interested candidates who are local to NYC and available for onsite work, please share your updated resume at abhay@sourceinfotech.com
comment: For EV analytics roles, data quality and lineage are often the hidden challenges. Strong SQL and dashboards matter, but understanding source systems and validation logic is what makes insights reliable.
